profile_text.body:
Pega describes itself as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation. According to its site, large organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company says its AI is grounded in best practices with governance built in, and that its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight so customers can orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. Named offerings on the site include Pega Platform, which the company describes as unifying AI for mission-critical work, and Pega Blueprint, an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together at design time. Pega states that it has served large organizations since 1983.

PegaSystems Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, and traded under the ticker PEGA. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001013857. No lawsuits involving the company are listed, and its legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts. No products or MCP servers are tracked for it in the material reviewed.
